text:
Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which 
 must performed on an annually bases Y1 as indicated in the above title 
 block. The first draft initiated by eng Ahmed Ismaeel Zen 
El_Abdeen from Bany Sowaif west 132kv substation, Middle Egypt
Safety Precautions
Isolation and proper earthing is required.
Wear 
safety helmet, shoes, safety belt.
Secondary CT wiring could 
be energized back feeds, ensure
 that circuit brcaker to secondary wiring in open.
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,
Isolation and proper earthing is required.
Wear 
safety helmet, shoes, safety belt.
Secondary CT wiring could 
be energized back feeds, ensure
 that circuit brcaker to secondary wiring in open.
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet, safety belt, Rags, and silicagel
Works to be Carried Out
Check oil level
Observe the possible oil leakage, if any leakage is detected
 tighten carefully the corresponding bolts and nuts
Take oil sample
Inspect the colour in the breather silica gel, when silica
 gel has grown red the unit should be removed and replaced by a new one, the
 breather with damp silica gel should be dismantled, silica gel should be
 changed.
Inspect the state of contact surface for absent of dirt,
 dints cracks
Remove and clean dust, soot, etc.
